info.title: tracks API
info.description: Backend for the tracks iOS app. Times are ISO 8601 with the UK offset and no fractional seconds; dates are YYYY-MM-DD (UK); station codes are upper-case CRS. Errors use the `Error` envelope with a stable `code`.

get.description: Ranked: exact CRS, then name prefix, then word prefix, then contains.
The position is used for this lookup only and is not stored.

get.summary: Timetabled departures from a station on a date
get.description: Passenger trains leaving `crs` on `date`, including trains that started the previous day and call after midnight. Paged by `cursor` (`nextCursor` from the previous page). For today's trains each item carries a `live` overlay from Darwin (Phase 4; null until then). 503 `schedule_not_loaded` before the first timetable import.

get.summary: A train run: calling points and route
get.description: The timetable for one run of a train after short-term (STP) changes. 404 `train_not_running` when it is cancelled or not a passenger train that day. Calling points carry `live` data once Darwin has the run (Phase 4).

503.description: A data source is not ready (`schedule_not_loaded`, `service_unavailable`)

get.description: `past`: archived, arrived, or scheduled arrival gone by while the train is not running (a late train stays upcoming until it arrives); newest first. `upcoming`: everything else, soonest first. `nextPollSeconds` says when to refresh while the list is open.

200.description: Journeys with a live summary each

post.summary: Save a journey on a timetabled train
post.description: Checks the train runs on `runDate` and calls at `fromCrs` then `toCrs`, snapshots its calling points and starts tracking. Returns 201 for a new journey, or 200 with the existing one (un-archived) if this device already saved the same trip. Past run dates are accepted while the timetable still covers them (they appear under `past`); otherwise 404 `train_not_running`. 422 `station_not_on_route` if the train does not pick up at `fromCrs` or set down at `toCrs` after it.

201.description: The saved journey (200 if it already existed)

503.description: A data source is not ready (`schedule_not_loaded`, `service_unavailable`)

get.summary: A saved journey with its current live status

patch.summary: Change notification overrides or archive a journey

delete.summary: Delete a journey; stops tracking and ends its Live Activity

get.summary: Just the live status of a journey
get.description: Cheap to poll while the app is open: it reads stored state and never calls upstream. Respect `nextPollSeconds`. Until live tracking (Phase 4) this is the timetable view: state `scheduled`, no service/progress/position.

put.summary: Register the push token of a Live Activity the app started for this journey

204.description: Registered; the server will push updates to it

delete.summary: The user ended the Live Activity; stop pushing to it
